purpose: Response shapes for the later appointment screen (FUCQ-120) and the order-progress UI (FUCQ-167 completed outcome). Backend-only story: no screen, so screenshots are inapplicable. Asserted by server/test/gcsp-lifecycle-appointment.test.js.

routes.GET /api/gcsp/appointments?orderUuid=: ok readModel; employee (own order), greg or presenter; forbidden for another employee; unsupported query keys are invalid
routes.POST /api/gcsp/appointments/request: { orderUuid, slotId } -> ok readModel (state requested, booked false); employee only; repeat returns the same appointment; another slot is a conflict; before sent to ordering it is a conflict
routes.POST /api/gcsp/appointments/accept: { orderUuid, proposalId } -> ok readModel (state scheduled, booked true); employee only; conflict when nothing is proposed
routes.POST /api/gcsp/appointments/no-show: { orderUuid } -> ok readModel (state no-show, booked false, outcome set, attempt, previousAttempts, offeredSlots fresh so Paula can rebook); presenter or greg only; conflict appointment-not-scheduled unless scheduled; the order stays allocated; repeat returns the same outcome; the live stub is unsupported
routes.POST /api/gcsp/appointments/request (reb: { orderUuid, slotId } on a no-show appointment -> ok readModel (state requested, attempt n+1, previousAttempts holds the missed attempt); employee only (the owner); history is append-only; repeat returns the same appointment
routes.POST /api/gcsp/appointments/complete: { orderUuid } -> ok readModel (state completed, booked false, outcome set); presenter or greg only; conflict handover-not-ready until FUCQ-116 reports documents and car ready; conflict appointment-not-scheduled; unavailable handover-readiness-unavailable without the readiness port; repeat returns the same outcome

requested.nextStep: Waiting for the retailer to confirm your slot.

change-proposed.nextStep: Accept the new time to confirm your handover.

pending.nextStep: Waiting for the scheme team to confirm the last update.

scheduled.nextStep: The retailer prepares your car for the handover.

no-show.nextStep: Your handover was missed. Choose a new slot to rebook.
